comment: He is the comic book professor. 100% WOULD TAKE AGAIN
He's a nice guy but expects a lot. If you're not good at art don't take a class with him.

Great professor. Grades hard and expects great work. Does not put up with bs. Took Graphic Novels and comics and learned a lot about the medium and about drawing, design and storytelling in general. Very laid back, but doesn't have a problem with calling you out if you don't pull your weight. Powerful beard.
